meta: Custom software development for web, mobile and APIs on .NET, Angular and Python. Secure by design, tested before launch and ready for audit.
h1: Custom software built around how your business runs
lead: Web, mobile and API software with security designed in from the first sprint, tested before launch and handed over with full documentation.

blocks.lead: From customer portals to internal platforms.

items.p: Customer portals, internal systems and real-time dashboards on ASP.NET Core and Angular.
iOS and Android apps with secure login and encrypted data, connected to your systems.
REST and GraphQL APIs and secure connections to payment providers, CRMs, ERPs and partners.
Company websites, WordPress themes and plugins, and WooCommerce stores.
Move aging systems to current platforms in stages, without stopping the business.
Reporting pipelines, dashboards and workflow automation that replace manual spreadsheet work.

blocks.lead: Security and quality are part of the build, not a separate phase.

items: Content security policy and XSS hardening
Secrets kept out of source code

blocks.lead: Six stages, each with a clear result.
items: We define goals, users, scope and how success will be measured.
We design a scalable architecture and a roadmap aligned with your business.
Short sprints with a working demo at the end of each one.
Security checks are built into the pipeline and every environment.
QA, load testing and a security test before anything goes live.
Staged release, documentation, training and ongoing support if you want it.

blocks.lead: Choose the model that fits your project and your team.

items.p: A defined build with an agreed price and timeline, delivered in short sprints.
Engineers who work only on your product, month to month, alongside your own team.
Updates, fixes, monitoring and security patches after launch.

blocks.lead: What is handed over when the project is done.
items: A deployment pipeline you can run yourself
Handover and training for your team

blocks.lead: Something missing? Ask on the consultation call and we will answer it straight.
items: Can you take over an application that another team built?
Yes. We start with a security assessment, then agree a plan to stabilize, secure and extend it.

We recommend based on your team, budget and integrations, not our preferences. ASP.NET Core and Angular are common for enterprise systems, and we choose mobile technology based on what your app needs.
How do you work day to day?
In short sprints with a demo at the end of each one. Projects can be fixed-scope, a dedicated team, or billed monthly.

items.p: Portals, dashboards and business systems on .NET and Angular.
Secure pipelines, containers and cloud infrastructure.
Manual testing with a report your developers and auditors can use.
